def add(left, right):
    return left + right


def clamp(value, lower, upper):
    """Return value limited to the inclusive range [lower, upper].

    Values below lower return lower and values above upper return upper.
    Raises ValueError if lower is greater than upper.
    """
    if lower > upper:
        raise ValueError(
            f"lower ({lower!r}) must not be greater than upper ({upper!r})"
        )
    if value < lower:
        return lower
    if value > upper:
        return upper
    return value
